title: UX.md v1.0 YAML Frontmatter Schema
description: Machine-verifiable YAML frontmatter contract for UX.md structural UI/UX specifications (app shell budget, breakpoints, monotonic z-index scale, interaction thresholds, and mandatory layout primitives).

platform_profile.description: Target runtime and primary input modality.

token_source.description: Visual token source file (`DESIGN.md` when paired with a sibling DESIGN.md, otherwise `standalone`).

scroll_owner.description: Single primary scroll container owner preventing nested full-height scrollbars.

breakpoints.description: Responsive viewport breakpoint boundaries in pixels.

mobile_max.description: Maximum viewport width in px for the mobile layout.

tablet_max.description: Maximum viewport width in px for the tablet layout.

desktop_min.description: Minimum viewport width in px for the persistent desktop app shell.

shell_budget.description: Spatial pixel budget at the desktop reference viewport. Must satisfy left_nav_px + right_panel_px + outer_padding_px + content_min_px <= desktop_viewport unless collapse_priority is declared.

desktop_viewport.description: Reference desktop viewport width in px.

left_nav_px.description: Persistent left navigation rail width in px.

right_panel_px.description: Persistent right dock/artifact panel width in px (0 when inspector opens as an overlay drawer).

outer_padding_px.description: Combined horizontal outer canvas padding (left + right) in px.

content_min_px.description: Minimum guaranteed primary content canvas width in px.

collapse_priority.description: Ordered responsive collapse sequence for fixed panels.

z_index_scale.description: Strictly monotonic elevation scale (base < sticky < navigation < drawer < modal < popover < toast < tooltip).

modal_max_fields.description: Maximum form fields permitted in a centered modal before requiring a slide-over drawer or route.

no_spinner_below_ms.description: Latency threshold in ms below which loading indicators are suppressed.

skeleton_min_ms.description: Latency threshold in ms at or above which geometry-matched skeletons render.

toast_auto_dismiss_ms.description: Auto-dismiss timer in ms for non-error toasts.

min_touch_target_px.description: Minimum interactive touch target width and height in px.

layout_primitives.description: Shared code layout primitives that all UI route files must compose.
